Ranks Nvidia the best stock to buy in October 2026; owns it (one of largest positions), preparing to buy more. DCF fair value $344 vs $230 (~50% upside 12-18mo). Forward PE 14.66 vs S&P 500 ~25. Bull: $150B add'l buyback ($235B total), full-stack AI factory moat, supplier leverage (TSMC etc.), Vera Rubin 30x tokens/MW, CPU growth doubling, resale values holding. Bear: AI data-center bubble fears, circular financing, AMD/ASIC competition — but risks already priced in, no investor complacency.
